headline: Anthropic survey finds a wide gap in public and staff expectations for AI and work
summary: Anthropic published an August 2026 survey comparing weighted responses from 10,980 US adults with unweighted responses from 1,334 Anthropic staff. The report finds large differences in respondents’ expectations about AI capability, adoption, time savings and automation of their own work by 2030. For example, 39% of US adults and 91% of staff expected AI to make a Nobel-level discovery by 2030; 5% of employed US respondents versus more than half of staff expected AI to perform at least 80% of their current work. Anthropic also maps complete-case responses through its economic scenario model: median answers imply 5.4% GDP growth for US adults and 17.1% for staff. These are survey responses and conditional model outputs, not measured capability, productivity, employment or forecast accuracy.
